faq.q: What is the origin of Shafiq?
faq.a: Shafiq is associated with Arabic. Shafiq is Arabic شَفِيق (Shafīq), meaning 'compassionate, tender'.
Yes — the underlying form شَفِيق is Arabic.
Shafiq can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
